summary: 071 validly converges the two former Windows-only proof gaps to Linux-hosted semantic simulations. The unreadable-Guidance contract is platform-agnostic at the resolver boundary and is proven by real low-privilege EACCES; the Git-mode contract is independently reproduced with core.filemode=false plus index chmod while bytes remain identical and candidateRef changes. Native Windows execution is no longer required by the Owner-corrected scope. Because this upstream Explore changed after 070, the existing 069 planning artifacts are now stale and 070 applyAllowed cannot be reused; planning must be regenerated through Propose.
